verdict.line: You win by using E to drag Mundo into forced melee and finishing with Ignite before his regen catches up; you lose if you trade at range into his Q poke or let the fight drag past his Sadism window without anti-heal.

brief.thesis: Dr. Mundo has no hard CC and wins only through ranged max-health poke from Q (Infected Cleaver, 975 range) and passive/ultimate HP regen, while Mordekaiser's E (Death's Grasp, 700 range) forcibly pulls him into melee where Darkness Rise's aura and bonus move speed let Mordekaiser outpace that regen. That structural mismatch is why Mordekaiser sits at 57.6% win rate over 236 games despite this looking like an even matchup on paper.

tell.watch: Mundo's HP bar during Burning Agony

theirWindow.what: Mundo throws Infected Cleaver (4s cooldown, 975 range) from outside your 700-range E and 675-range Q. Don't trade autos at this range; back off and last-hit until E comes online at level 2.

yourWindow.when: Right after E lands on him
yourWindow.what: Death's Grasp pulls him into melee range — follow immediately with Q (Obliterate) for its single-target bonus damage. His W (Burning Agony) drains his own health while active, so extending the fight after the pull favors you.

start.why: Sustains you through Mundo's early Q poke (4s cooldown, max-health scaling) and gives mana for repeated E-into-Q trades once you're forcing fights.

boots.why: 59.3% win rate in this matchup; cuts the basic-attack damage Mundo deals once your E has forced him into melee range.

core.why: The slow on Q and E helps keep him inside Death's Grasp range and sets up a clean R engage.
Omnivamp and the stacking burn let you out-sustain his Adrenaline Rush regen in extended trades.
Burn stacks scale off his max-health pool, the same stat his kit and regen are built around.

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing reward the prolonged melee trades you're forcing, directly countering his passive regen.

summoners.why: 60.4% win rate and 80.5% pick rate; Ignite's grievous wounds directly answers his passive regen and Sadism sustain so your E-into-R all-in actually kills instead of getting outhealed.

playing.title: Hold E for his engage, not yours
playing.detail: Death's Grasp (16/14/12/10/8s cooldown, 700 range) pulls enemies in the area to you. Save it for when he steps up to throw Q rather than wasting it to poke.

playing.title: Never trade at max range
playing.detail: His Q outranges your entire kit at 975 range. Eat the poke or dodge it, then close with E before trading.

playing.title: Stack passive before committing R
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 hits on champions or monsters. Land it before you drag him into Realm of Death so the aura and move speed carry the isolated fight.

playing.title: Buy anti-heal on OP.GG's cue
playing.detail: Bramble Vest first, carried into Oblivion Orb or Thornmail, directly blunts Adrenaline Rush — this is the single highest-leverage item decision in the matchup.

playing.title: Time R around his Sadism
playing.detail: Realm of Death (140/120/100/90/80s cooldown, 650 range) isolates him 1v1. Use it when he's about to pop Sadism to retreat — Sadism only buys him time, it doesn't threaten a kill.

playing.title: Respect low-HP Masochism spikes
playing.detail: His E gives him attack damage based on missing health for a few seconds. Don't assume he's harmless at 20% HP mid-trade.

playing.title: Shove waves with banked W shield
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken into a shield you can consume to heal. Use it to push the wave safely while his Burning Agony burns his own HP to contest you.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Bramble Vest foremost when facing Dr. Mundo. After reaching level 3, maintain your [P] when fighting him to gain the upper hand.
